description: This file defines the EmployeeDeletedEvent class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an Event base class and encapsulates data related to employee deletion events, specifically storing an array of employee numbers.

classes.name: EmployeeDeletedEvent
classes.description: Represents an event triggered upon deletion of employee(s), encapsulating their employee numbers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDeletedEvent with a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers associated with this event.
